summary: Re-tested the persisted appointment fix and completed live API plus browser regression coverage. Appointment creation, visual confirmation, fresh-browser management listing, and 390px mobile layout all passed.
action_items: Consider handling a failed POST /api/appointments before showing confirmation; reserve currently ignores non-OK responses and can display a locally confirmed booking that was rejected by the API.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js reserve() performs fire-and-forget POST without checking response.ok; duplicate/conflict or backend failure can produce a false confirmation and local-only appointment.
test_credentials: Not applicable; no auth flow tested.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST FreshSession appointment through the live booking flow; retained as persisted test data for this preview regression.
context_for_next_testing_agent: API CRUD regression passed. Browser verified homepage, complete booking, visual confirmation, same-session management, fresh browser-session management from GET /api/appointments, and 390px no horizontal overflow. One initial assertion was corrected because confirmation intentionally displays only the first name; no product defect.
rca of the issue: The prior cross-session issue is fixed by the App-level GET /api/appointments effect, which hydrates state on a new browser session. Remaining risk is reserve() updating local state and closing the modal regardless of the POST response, so API rejection is not surfaced to the customer.
